documents.note: New page. Every sentence is listed. A sentence that describes several articles maps to the first article it names.

sentences.text: Models is the desk for choosing how a software company makes money and reaches customers.
The choice shapes what you build first, whom you hire and how you talk to buyers.
sentences.page: src/content/insights/models/b2b-saas-how-the-model-works-and-what-it-asks-of-a-first-company.mdx#What the model asks of a first company

sentences.text: The eight articles on this desk describe the main models in plain terms: business-to-business SaaS, vertical SaaS, marketplaces, platforms and ecosystems, seat, usage and hybrid pricing, product-led and sales-led growth, API-first products and open-core businesses.
Each one says what the model asks of a first company and what it cannot tell you.

sentences.text: The articles on this desk follow that order.

They cover a founder-led sequence for the first ten customers, onboarding as the final step of acquisition, the fundamentals of a first pricing page, a lightweight way to run support when the customer base is small, the retention measures worth keeping and feedback loops that reach the product.
